'''Fish Stew''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|175}}. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (7% chance).<ref name="chestchance" /> One Fish Stew may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].
